svg.text: claudia — Fonts where people meet them: on opening, in the style's font field, and adding a missing one, proposed
A: composes on Studio server (the same bar in computes and creates). B: StyleFontPicker.vue, fed by the catalogue. C: the desktop clients; the web client offers only a file.
Only when the page may differ from how it was written (Missing, Other
2 fonts are not as written on Studio server: the
footer and endnotes may break differently.
City of Example · Department 4 · page 3 of 12
Lists only fonts a page can be laid out with: the document's own,
The running line at the bottom of each page
Add a font to this document…
C · Add a font to this document
Desktop clients: from this computer's installed fonts, or a file. The
Segoe UI allows embedding in documents that can be edited
(fsType 8). It is kept inside “report” only, as Word does with
embedded fonts, and goes wherever the document goes.
Also add it to this computer's Claudia server, for
Shown once per person and document, closed with ×. The print
preview keeps naming the family it replaced, as now (D905).
Optional: View ▸ Show Fonts Not as Written tints the text set in a
missing or other-version font, like Show Who Wrote What.
The fixed list in lib/fonts.ts (Georgia, Arial, Verdana …) goes: the
layout library can only use catalogue fonts, so names the server
lacks would be promises it cannot keep. Each name in its own face.
Still possible, for a document going to someone with that font: it is
written into the style and shows as Missing, with what is used
May be kept: the font's embedding bits allow editable documents
(installable or editable). Preview-and-print-only and restricted fonts
cannot be added. Firefox has no API to list installed fonts, so the
web client asks for a file.
Shown only when the client runs its own local server: the font then
joins a collection “From this computer” (◐ This server).
